an5.126:1.3: asappāyakārī hoti, sappāye mattaṃ na jānāti, aparinatabhojī ca hoti, dussīlo ca, pāpamitto ca.
an5.126:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā anāyussā.
an5.126:2.3: sappāyakārī hoti, sappāye mattaṃ jānāti, parinatabhojī ca hoti, sīlavā ca, kalyāṇamitto ca.
an5.126:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā āyussā
